query_sql: SELECT k, count(*) AS n FROM bench_raw_integer_count GROUP BY k
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE bench_raw_integer_count (k int8, value boolean, qualifies boolean)

INSERT INTO bench_raw_integer_count SELECT CASE WHEN i % 97 = 0 THEN NULL::int8 ELSE (g - 32)::int8 END, CASE WHEN i % 7 = 0 THEN NULL::boolean ELSE i % 2 = 0 END, CASE WHEN g = 0 THEN false WHEN i % 11 = 0 THEN NULL::boolean ELSE i % 3 <> 0 END FROM (SELECT i, CASE WHEN i > 64 AND i % 5 = 0 THEN 0 ELSE (i - 1) % 64 END AS g FROM generate_series(1::bigint, 1000017) AS s(i)) AS fixture
